entities.name: Asterion
entities.description: A statue spirit and mentor of Quintorius at Strixhaven, a whimsical figure who died in a fall centuries ago while seeking Zantafar.

entities.name: Quintorius Kand
entities.description: Lorehold student mentored by Asterion who discovers Zantafar.

entities.name: Hofri Ghostforge
entities.description: Professor at the dig site who almost caught Quint.

entities.name: Vis Svokunol
entities.description: Loxodon friend of Asterion, unjustly executed.

entities.name: Effigy Row
entities.description: Place where spirit statues must stay.

entities.name: Pillardrop
entities.description: Place with a cave and monument where Asterion was last seen.

entities.name: Zantafar
entities.description: Lost city Asterion sought, found beneath a cave in Pillardrop.

entities.name: Canticle of Jed
entities.description: Part of the legend whose recitation opened the hidden passage.

events.summary: Quint summons Asterion for a fourth session, and Asterion asks to leave Effigy Row.
events.quote: Asterion, however, expressed a desire to leave Effigy Row and explore the campus

events.summary: Asterion insists on visiting the cave at Pillardrop despite the rules.
events.quote: Asterion insisted on visiting this cave

events.summary: Quint sneaks Asterion past researchers, avoiding Professor Ghostforge.
events.quote: They snuck past a group of researchers and professors at the dig site

events.summary: Asterion reveals he sought Zantafar, and Quint follows him into the cave.
events.quote: Asterion shared that he was searching for the lost city of Zantafar

events.summary: In the cave Asterion tells of his friend Vis's unjust execution.
Quint recites the Canticle of Jed, opening a passage to Zantafar.
events.quote: This recitation triggered a hidden mechanism

events.summary: They find Asterion's mummified body and stand before Zantafar.
events.quote: they found Asterion’s own mummified body

relations.quote: Asterion was introduced as the spirit mentor of Quintorius
